description: Propose a new text for a rikma's playbook - the rikma-wide one, or one role's (roleId). Pass the WHOLE new text, not a diff: read it first with getPlaybookTool and change only what the user asked. In a rikma of one it is written at once; otherwise every member can approve it, it is approved by silence when the rikma clock runs out, and a newer proposal for the same playbook replaces this one. Use it for a rule of how the rikma works that came up in the work ("business customers pay net+30") - only with the user's yes, in their words. A rule that commits the rikma outward (a price, a discount, a refund policy) is a decision of the rikma, not a playbook line: tell the user so. A fact about one customer goes on the lead (logLeadActivityTool), not here. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#proposePlaybookUpdateTool

body.description: The whole new playbook text, plain text, in the rikma's language.

roleId.description: A role (tafkid) id for that role's playbook; omit for the rikma-wide one.

title.description: A short title, e.g. "Sales - how we work".

why.description: One line on what changed and why, for the members (not stored in the text).

name: proposePlaybookUpdateTool
